# Deagle Labs

> Privilege-safe legal AI for solo, small, and mid-size firms. Built for litigators. Verified citations. Six autonomous agents. Deploys in your cloud or fully air-gapped. Starting at $49/month per seat with no minimum.

Deagle is a legal document intelligence platform competing with Harvey, CoCounsel, and Lexis+ AI. It is built for the post-Heppner era (Heppner v. Allied, SDNY, Feb 10 2026) — meaning every architectural choice prioritizes attorney-client privilege preservation. Tenant-isolated inference. No training on customer data. Three deployment tiers: cloud SaaS, BYOC (Helm chart on AWS/GCP/Azure), and fully air-gapped via the VaultAI hardware partnership.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://deaglelabs.com/): One-page overview of the platform.
- [Free trial](https://demo.deaglelabs.com): 14-day self-serve trial, no credit card.
- [Sign in](https://app.deaglelabs.com): Customer application.

## Architecture

- Hybrid retrieval: BGE-M3 dense + SPLADE/BM42 sparse + Neo4j citation graph + reranker
- Six LangGraph multi-agent orchestrator: Reader, Gatekeeper, Cite-Checker, Pen, Skeptic, Cross
- Chain-of-Verification (CoVe): every citation re-fetched and pin-cite-matched before delivery
- Reported hallucination rate: <1% on the Stanford HAI Magesh et al. 202-question benchmark
- EDRM v2.0 ingest, Bates numbering, F.R.C.P. 26(b)(5) privilege log generation

## Pricing

- **Solo** — $49/seat/month. 50 documents/month. All 6 agents. Cloud SaaS. SOC 2 Type II.
- **Practice** — $149/seat/month. Unlimited. SSO/SCIM. Deposition live-mode. 4-hour Slack SLA.
- **Sovereign** — BYOC or air-gapped. Helm/K8s 1.28+. VaultAI appliance option. FIPS 140-3.

## Comparison versus alternatives

- Harvey AI: ~$100/seat/month, 20-seat minimum, no air-gap, no BYOC.
- CoCounsel (Thomson Reuters): $225/user/month, no air-gap, no BYOC.
- Lexis+ AI: quote-only, 17% hallucination rate per Stanford HAI, no air-gap.
- Westlaw Precision: 33% hallucination rate per Stanford HAI.

## Compliance

- SOC 2 Type II
- Tenant-isolated keys
- Customer-managed KMS (Sovereign tier)
- FIPS 140-3 cryptography (Sovereign tier)
- DPA with Heppner-aligned indemnification
